description: An MCP server that exposes Roslyn and MSBuild to agents: navigation, analysis, refactoring, builds and tests, IL/JIT disassembly, decompilation, process inspection and debugging of C# projects.
releaseNotes: - A solution whose projects reference each other loads all of them when none was restored yet. The design-time builds restored in parallel, each also restoring the projects it references, and could break one another's restore (NETSDK1004): a project then loaded without its code, so tools missed it, as change_signature missed the calls in a referencing project.
